outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot.

The bottom bar graph (mean ± SEM, n=3) overlays individual data points as distinct markers (circles, squares, triangles) for each condition. The top flow-cytometry density plots are representative raw data, not averaged summaries.
The bottom bar graph (mean ± SD, n=3) shows individual data points overlaid on the bars for each of the three conditions.
Panel E is a heatmap of normalized expression values; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Both bar graphs (mean ± SEM, n=3) show individual data points as markers overlaid on each bar for every gene/condition.
Panel H shows immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
